definition: Stable result ID tied to release, code commit, wave, and model specification.
Official CHARLS release name/version and version-specific source identity; do not publish private microdata file hashes.

verified_official_source, unavailable_pending_authorized_file, or unresolved. A successful fit requires independently verified official release identity; a local file hash alone does not satisfy this gate.

official_checksum_recorded, private_local_sha256_recorded, unavailable_pending_authorized_file, or unresolved. A successful fit requires one of the first two; the private manifest must actually contain the corresponding verification evidence.
release_rule: Public status only after review; never expose private hash
